items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: He played Bucktown with Dan Tagnett and Valley Reap the drum.

ctx.x: Did you know Joe Garrow? Joe Garrow, yeah. You remember that? Yes. You played with Joe Garrow. You're a banjo player. He used to play.

No. This boy, he wouldn't put an extra noise, he'd ruin the tune. What do you know? He wouldn't put an extra noise, he'd ruin the tune. I know. He wouldn't put an extra noise. He wouldn't put an extra noise. This played a chord. Well, I know he's a bar. I wouldn't play a Joe Garrow. I know. No, no. This one played the piano. This guy played the piano. He was on sheet music and all Joe Garrow. He played Bucktown with Dan Tagnett and Valley Reap the drum. Valley Reap.
